items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for second straight day after exiting Week 4 early; week-to-week and unlikely for Week 5 vs JAX in London.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring; Schefter and beat reports confirm week-to-week.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thinned with Bigsby also out/IR; elevated role for backups.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries for remaining RBs vs soft run D possible.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP Thursday again after missing Week 4; status in serious doubt for Week 5.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; thins already depleted Eagles WR corps with Brown also out.
items.implication: More targets to remaining WRs/TEs; Hurts efficiency hit.
items.opportunity: Increased route/target share for depth WRs.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP Thursday; Friday practice key for Sunday Night availability vs ATL, but Rapoport views as unlikely with unconventional sprain, possible multi-week.
items.why: Missed practices post-Week 4 exit; outside chance only.
items.implication: Huntley likely start; Ravens offense downgrade.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; Ravens skill upside variance.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore DNP Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Allen target distribution change if sits.
items.opportunity: More looks to other Bills pass-catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice Thursday (again) with foot/ribs; status uncertain vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Increased share for other Chargers WRs.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); coach says miss multiple weeks.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for remaining Steelers WRs.

items.text: Levitan notes Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities YTD; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming.
items.why: xFP vs actual data from ETR.
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch; trust process on over/under.
items.opportunity: Positive regression potential for underperformers if volume holds.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
items.opportunity: If out, other TEN WRs rise.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8 for Week 5 due to volume/red-zone and matchup.
items.why: Target hog vs struggling Titans D.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume and red-zone usage vs soft secondary.
items.why: Seeing target/red-zone volume in good matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload plus Bengals injury context and soft run D.
items.why: Featured role vs weak Miami front.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
Berry hates Mark Andrews @ ATL as TE17; thin role and tough usage numbers.
Thorman/ETR: DET @ ARI up in pace as highest-total main-slate matchup (54.5); Lions high snaps/points environments. SF@SEA slow.
items.why: Neutral pace/snaps data favor high-volume game.
